Subject: Request: IC->Manager promotion comp exception — Anika Shah

Hi team,

I want to start a quick thread to surface a promotion request for Anika Shah (Sr Software Engineer, East platform team) to an Engineering Manager role effective 2027-03-01. Anika has run an ad-hoc leadership loop over the last 9 months and is the de-facto manager for the East infra pod (people: 3 ICs + 1 L4). The manager role won't map to her current band without an exception.

Ask: approval for an exception to the standard promotion comp packet so we can: 1) increase base by $22,000 (above band) for market parity and internal equity, 2) grant a mid-cycle equity refresh at 0.18% (accelerated refresh), and 3) approve a one-time discretionary onboarding bonus of $7,500 as a retention signal.

Attachments: Anika_Shah_promo_packet.pdf (bio, manager readiness notes), comp_proposal_Anika.xlsx (proposed comp lines + cost delta).

Context:
- Performance: Exceeds expectations on reliability and mentorship; multiple skip-level nominations.
- Org: East infra has no tenured manager and the gap is increasing risk to delivery.
- Cost: preliminary cost delta is ~$86k FY27 (salary+pro-rata equity+bonus).

I know this triggers both compensation policy exception and finance confirmation. Laura / Marissa — can you confirm the approvals needed and whether we should route to exec compensation committee this week? Vivek — I can add you to the packet if you want more background.

Thanks,
Sean
--
Sean Gallagher
Director, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference

Thanks for the clear packet, Sean. Two quick notes:

1) We need manager calibration evidence (peer manager feedback + two skip-level 1:1 notes). Please add short bullets in the packet to show scope of direct reports, current span, and expected hiring plan for the role.

2) Any compensation exception above band requires sign-off from Exec Comp and Finance. I'll triage the packet to Exec Comp for a fast-track review, but Marissa will need the cost delta split by FY27/FY28 and an ROI rationale (impact on retention/delivery).

I suggest we also run the proposed numbers by external market comp (Paul at CompBench) for an objective check — looping in Emily from PeopleOps Consulting to coordinate if needed.

If Exec Comp is needed I can put it on Thursday's emergency agenda; otherwise we can do an email sign-off. Please update the packet with the items above and re-send.

Laura

Laura / Sean — I've reviewed the attached comp_proposal_Anika.xlsx and the high-level ask looks reasonable given market movement. A few items we need before finance can approve:

- FY27 vs FY28 cost split (please include salary proration and equity vesting schedule).
- Headcount coding (should this convert an IC headcount to a manager headcount?)
- Any planned hiring/hardening of the team in 90/180 days that would change the budget baseline.

From a policy perspective, the one-time discretionary bonus is allowable but needs a documented business rationale (retention / critical role). For the equity refresh, we prefer to keep refreshes aligned to refresh cadence but are open to an exception for critical hires — we'll want to cap the grant if Exec Comp approves.

Looping in Emily so she can set up a quick market check with CompBench (Paul). Emily — can you run a 30-minute market check by EOD tomorrow and share a short memo with percentile data?

If we get those items by EOD Wednesday I'll give a provisional finance thumbs-up and Laura can route to Exec Comp if necessary.

Marissa
